sources.title: Public Law 119-27, GENIUS Act (S. 1582)
sources.notes: Statute text read 2026-10-11. Approved 2025-07-18. Section 20: effective on the earlier of 18 months after enactment or 120 days after the primary Federal payment stablecoin regulators issue final regulations. Section 9 asks Treasury to seek comment on innovative AML detection methods, listing artificial intelligence; no provision addresses AI agents as payers.

sources.title: Text of the approved CCPA regulations on cybersecurity audits, risk assessments, automated decisionmaking technology and insurance
sources.notes: Read 2026-10-18 and 2026-10-20 (PDF text, 127 pages). Section 7200(a): a business that uses ADMT to make a significant decision concerning a consumer must comply with the ADMT article; 7200(b): a business using ADMT for a significant decision before 2027-01-01 must comply by 2027-01-01. Section 7001 defines ADMT as technology that replaces or substantially replaces human decisionmaking, and a significant decision as one that results in the provision or denial of financial or lending services, housing, education, employment or independent contracting, or healthcare services.

sources.title: Sanctions Compliance Guidance for the Virtual Currency Industry
sources.publisher: US Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control
sources.notes: Brochure PDF read 2026-10-19. Page 1: sanctions compliance obligations apply equally to transactions in virtual and fiat currencies. events.title: GENIUS Act signed (Public Law 119-27)
events.detail: First US federal framework for payment stablecoins. It takes effect on the earlier of 2027-01-18 or 120 days after final implementing rules. It does not address AI agents as payers.

events.title: CFPB reopens the open banking rule (section 1033 reconsideration)
events.detail: The advance notice asks who may act as a consumer's representative, a question that will shape agent access to account data. It is not an agent rule.

events.title: Canada's Retail Payment Activities Act fully in force
events.detail: From this date payment service providers must have risk management and funds safeguarding frameworks under Bank of Canada supervision.

events.title: Visa's rules add requirements for agentic payments
events.detail: The 2025-10-18 edition of the Visa Core Rules and Visa Product and Service Rules added the Visa Intelligent Commerce program to the rules (effective 2025-11-04 in Chile). The rules govern Visa and its member institutions and yield to applicable law. An Agentic Payment Provider must enroll in the program and register with Visa, and may not combine several agent purchases into one transaction. Within Visa's system, the cardholder is responsible for its actions in an Agentic Transaction as if the cardholder had initiated it. Visa calls none of these agent rules a liability shift.

events.title: Amazon sues Perplexity over the Comet shopping agent
events.detail: Amazon alleges computer fraud (CFAA) and California CDAFA violations and asks for a preliminary injunction against agent access to Amazon accounts.

events.title: EU reaches provisional agreement on PSD3 and the Payment Services Regulation
events.detail: Political deal between Parliament and Council. As of 2026-10-11 no Official Journal publication was found. The texts have no agent-specific provisions.

events.title: US district court enjoins Perplexity's agent from Amazon accounts
events.detail: Judge Chesney grants Amazon a preliminary injunction. The Ninth Circuit stays it on 2026-03-16 pending appeal. Exact dates come from press reports; the appellate opinion says March 2026.

events.title: FCA payments priorities name agentic AI payments
events.detail: The FCA says it will work with HM Treasury and consider whether payments regulation needs to change to support agentic AI payments.

events.title: Canada's Stablecoin Act receives Royal Assent in Bill C-15
events.detail: Part of the Budget 2025 Implementation Act, No. 1 (S.C. 2026, c. 3). The Act was not in force on 2026-10-19; orders of the Governor in Council will set its commencement. Once in force, the Bank of Canada will supervise issuers, and the framework is expected in 2027.

events.title: Senator Warner asks Treasury about AI agents in finance
events.detail: Letter to Treasury Secretary Bessent asks Treasury to examine agentic payment rails and how existing law allocates liability when agents make errors or enable fraud.

events.title: MiCA transitional period for crypto-asset service providers ends
events.detail: Firms without MiCA authorization must stop serving EU clients and run their wind-down plans. Some member states ended the period earlier.

events.title: HM Treasury consults on modernising payment services regulation
events.detail: The consultation (closed 2026-10-06) asks how authentication, consent and liability rules should adapt for agentic payments, alongside tokenised payments and Open Banking.

events.title: EU Digital Omnibus on AI enters into force
events.detail: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 moves Annex III high-risk obligations to 2027-12-02 and Annex I to 2028-08-02, and adds a grace period to 2026-12-02 for Article 50(2) marking by existing generative systems.

events.title: Worldpay: no liability shift yet for agent card payments
events.detail: Analysis from an acquirer: properly tokenized agent transactions follow existing rules, while liability for disputes short of fraud is unresolved.

events.title: EU AI Act general application date, including Article 50 transparency
events.detail: The general date of application of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, kept by the Digital Omnibus. Chatbot-style disclosure duties under Article 50 apply from here.

events.title: Ninth Circuit vacates the Amazon v. Perplexity injunction
events.detail: Published opinion: on this record the user, not Perplexity, accesses Amazon through the agent, so Amazon is unlikely to win its CFAA and CDAFA claims. Remanded; the court limited the ruling to its record.

events.title: EMVCo publishes a draft framework for card-based agentic payments
events.detail: Draft for comment until 2026-09-30, proposing Intent Services. EMVCo lists Know Your Agent and Agentic Transaction Indicators as possible future work.

events.title: Ant International, Mastercard and Visa start Know Your Agent interoperability work
events.detail: The three will explore common principles across their existing protocols (Visa TAP, Mastercard Verifiable Intent, Ant's Agentic Mobile Protocol), working through the MAS-convened BuildFin.ai platform and building on the SAFR framework. No network rule change announced.

events.title: MAS issues Guidelines on AI Risk Management
events.detail: Effective 2027-10-07, with some expectations phased to 2028-10-07. MAS plans to consult on more agentic AI guidance in 2027.

events.title: GENIUS Act latest effective date (scheduled)
events.detail: Eighteen months after enactment. Final rules issued after about 2026-09-20 cannot bring the date earlier, because 120 days would fall after 2027-01-18.
